results.question: Which components are overdue?

results.question: How many status changes have been recorded in total?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_logs

results.question: How many different workers have recorded a scan?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT worker_name) FROM status_logs WHERE worker_name IS NOT NULL

results.question: How many scans has each worker recorded?
results.generated:
SELECT worker_name, COUNT(*)
FROM status_logs
WHERE worker_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY worker_name
LIMIT 100

results.question: Which worker has recorded the most scans?
results.generated:
SELECT worker_name, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
FROM status_logs
WHERE worker_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY worker_name
ORDER BY scan_count DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many times has a component been flagged?
results.generated:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM status_logs
WHERE to_status = 'flagged'

results.question: How many times has a flagged component been sent back for rework?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_logs WHERE from_status = 'flagged' AND to_status = 'in_progress'

results.question: How many components have ever been marked completed?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT component_id) FROM status_logs WHERE to_status = 'completed'

results.question: Who last updated each component?
results.generated:
SELECT c.name, c.last_updated_by
FROM components c
LIMIT 100

results.question: How many status changes happened at each workstation?
results.generated:
SELECT w.name, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM status_logs s
JOIN workstations w ON w.id = s.workstation_id
GROUP BY w.name
LIMIT 100

results.question: Which workstation has the most status changes?
results.generated:
SELECT w.name
FROM status_logs s
JOIN workstations w ON w.id = s.workstation_id
GROUP BY w.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many distinct components has each workstation handled?
results.generated:
SELECT w.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.component_id)
FROM status_logs s
JOIN workstations w ON w.id = s.workstation_id
GROUP BY w.name
LIMIT 100

results.question: Which workstation has handled the most distinct components?
results.generated:
SELECT w.name
FROM status_logs s
JOIN workstations w ON w.id = s.workstation_id
GROUP BY w.id, w.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.component_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many components are currently at each workstation?
results.generated:
SELECT w.name, COUNT(c.id)
FROM workstations w
JOIN components c ON c.current_workstation_id = w.id
GROUP BY w.name
LIMIT 100

results.question: Which workstation has the fewest status changes?
results.generated:
SELECT w.name
FROM status_logs s
JOIN workstations w ON w.id = s.workstation_id
GROUP BY w.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1

results.question: How many status changes happened in the last 24 hours?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_logs WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

results.question: How many components were completed in the last 7 days?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_logs WHERE to_status = 'completed' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

results.question: How many status changes happened per day?
results.generated:
SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM status_logs
GROUP BY DATE(timestamp)
ORDER BY day
LIMIT 100

results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_logs WHERE timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE

results.question: How many components were completed today?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_logs WHERE to_status = 'completed' AND timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE

results.question: How many components were flagged today?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_logs WHERE to_status = 'flagged' AND timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE

results.question: Which component was updated most recently?
results.generated:
SELECT c.name
FROM components c
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which component was created first?

results.question: Which component was scanned most recently?
results.generated:
SELECT c.name
FROM status_logs s
JOIN components c ON c.id = s.component_id
ORDER BY s.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Which component has been scanned the most times?
results.generated:
SELECT c.name
FROM components c
JOIN status_logs s ON s.component_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: What are the top 3 most scanned components?
results.generated:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
FROM components c
JOIN status_logs s ON s.component_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY scan_count DESC
LIMIT 3

results.question: What is the average number of status changes per component?
results.generated:
SELECT COUNT(s.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 0) AS avg_status_changes_per_component
FROM components c
LEFT JOIN status_logs s ON s.component_id = c.id

results.question: What is the longest time a component waited between two status changes?
results.generated:
SELECT MAX(gap) AS longest_wait
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY component_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS gap
  FROM status_logs
) t

results.question: At each workstation, what is the average time a component had been waiting since its own previous scan?
results.generated:
SELECT w.name, AVG(s.timestamp - prev.prev_ts) AS avg_wait
FROM status_logs s
JOIN workstations w ON w.id = s.workstation_id
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT MAX(s2.timestamp) AS prev_ts
  FROM status_logs s2
  WHERE s2.component_id = s.component_id
    AND s2.timestamp < s.timestamp
) prev ON prev.prev_ts IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY w.name
LIMIT 100

results.question: How many components have never been scanned?
results.generated: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM components c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM status_logs s WHERE s.component_id = c.id)

results.question: How many scans does each component have?

FROM components c
LEFT JOIN status_logs s ON s.component_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
LIMIT 100
